name: council-policies-section19-eotas-alternative-provision
title: Council policies by area: section 19, EOTAS and alternative provision
description: A reference dataset of what the 153 local authorities in England responsible for education publish about education for children who cannot attend school: the section 19 or medical needs policy, the EOTAS policy or guidance where one is published, what the council publishes about alternative provision, and the free local SEND advice service for the area. 612 entries, one for each of the four kinds for each authority, each with the date it was checked. It records what each council publishes as found on the dates shown; it does not describe what any policy says.

sources.title: Council policies by area: section 19, EOTAS and alternative provision

resources.name: council-policies
resources.description: The current list. The file begins with a UTF-8 BOM so spreadsheet software reads it correctly.

fields.name: council
fields.description: The local authority's name, as it names itself. 153 distinct names.

fields.name: ons_code
fields.description: The Office for National Statistics code for the area, for example E06000015.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The grouping used on the page.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Which of the four kinds of document the row records. One row for each kind for each council.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether a document was found for this row.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The document's own title, as the council published it. Empty unless status is found.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The address of the document or page. Empty unless status is found.

fields.name: document_date
fields.description: The date shown on the document itself, or the council's last-updated date where the page carries one, copied as the council shows it. Empty when none.

fields.name: date_checked
fields.description: The date the row was last checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

enum: one check, on the council's own site

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: A short quotation from the source that shows why the row was recorded, with any email address removed. Usually empty.

fields.name: consultation_contacted_on
fields.description: The date the council or its advice service was asked about its entry. Empty when no contact has been made.

fields.name: consultation_followed_up_on
fields.description: The date of a follow-up contact. Empty when none.

fields.name: consultation_replied_on
fields.description: The date a reply was received. Empty when none.

fields.name: consultation_outcome
fields.description: Plain words for what came back. Empty when none.

resources.name: council-policies-json
resources.description: The current list as a JSON array of objects, one object per row, with the same columns as the CSV.
